title: Product runs whose team snapshot exists but whose independent audit persisted NO verdict
why_this_file_exists: Between runs 39025961835 and 39039195228 the product lane produced five consecutive team snapshots with no persisted audit verdict. The prior cycle's product/audit_pack.py docstring cited 'raw GitHub check-run annotations saved under results/product/orchestration/' for these failures; that directory was never committed, so the citations were not auditable from the tree. This file replaces them with evidence a third party can re-derive from the repository and the remote in one command, and it labels every claim by what it actually rests on.
how_to_reproduce: for r in 39039195228 39034350468 39031213637 39027045675 39025961835; do printf '%s team=%s audit=%s\n' "$r" "$(git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/cycle/core/product/$r/team | wc -l)" "$(git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/cycle/core/product/$r/audit | wc -l)"; done
git ls-files -- results/audit/product/ | grep -E 'CYCLE_(39039195228|39034350468|39031213637|39027045675|39025961835)_GATE.json'   # expect no output
git show <audit-sha>:results/audit/product/CYCLE_<run>_GATE.json | jq -c '{gate,safe_to_integrate}'  # for the two runs that DID get a verdict

detection_rule.non_verdicted: refs/heads/cycle/core/product/<run>/audit is ABSENT on origin. The audit job's final step is 'Persist audit snapshot', which pushes that branch. Absence therefore means no gate file was ever persisted, so the run has no verdict of any kind - it is NOT a PASS, NOT a REVISE and NOT a BLOCKED.
detection_rule.verdicted_not_promoted: the audit branch EXISTS but results/audit/product/CYCLE_<run>_GATE.json is absent from the accepted base (lab/product). A verdict was written and not accepted. This is a normal outcome, not an operational failure, and is listed separately so the two classes are never conflated.
detection_rule.accepted: the gate file is on the accepted base. Only 39019268074 is in this class.

non_verdicted_runs.producer_delta: product/audit_pack.py (935 lines, 18 committed-artifact checks), results/product/audit_pack/CYCLE_local_pack.json, four state/product.json readiness-claim corrections, product/tests/test_fixture_replay_and_wiring.py refactored onto the shared sweep predicate
non_verdicted_runs.proven: The team snapshot exists at 9275cc6 on both /team and /team-attempt-1; no /audit branch exists on origin; no CYCLE_39039195228_GATE.json exists on the accepted base. The team job's snapshot step is `if: always()`, so a persisted branch does NOT prove the team job's earlier steps passed - only that the snapshot was written.
non_verdicted_runs.not_proven: the exit code and the failing step of the audit job. No GitHub API credential is available to a lane agent (gh auth status: not logged in; job logs are admin-only over the public API), so check-run annotations cannot be read. This run is therefore recorded as UNATTRIBUTED. It is deliberately NOT assigned to 'auditor crossed scope' (exit 3) or LEX_WORK_QUANTUM_EXPIRED (exit 78): neither is evidenced for this run, and asserting one would convert an inference into a fact.
non_verdicted_runs.classification: PRODUCER WORK PRESENT AND PRESERVED; INDEPENDENT AUDIT VERDICT ABSENT

structural_reading.not_a_product_verdict: Five non-verdicts in a row is an orchestration signal, not five product rejections. Factory-wide requirement 20 already governs the largest family of causes (provider rotation / overload: an audit or producer job that dies on provider death is NOT a verdict, NOT a product defect and NOT a human-gate problem). No run in this file is evidence against the v52 endgame, and none of it may be cited as if a bar had been missed.
producer_side_mitigations_landed: product/audit_pack.py: one command that recomputes every v52 endgame claim from committed artifacts in ~11s, so the auditor verifies instead of reconstructing under the 2700s work quantum (the mechanism that is documented, for other runs, in reports/product/CYCLE_39011220761_RESUME.md)

product/audit_pack.py: the auditor's write scope is stated in the pack's own output as the exact two relative paths the workflow permits, because exit 3 'auditor crossed scope' is the one failure mode with a committed annotation (reports/product/CYCLE_38766812030.md)

claim_ceiling: This file reports workflow-orchestration facts only: which branches exist and which gate files are committed. It asserts no product quality, re-measures no frozen bar, scores no label or geometry criterion, and makes no claim about whether any decision is supporting, contrary or limiting. It does not assert that any of these runs passed or failed an audit - five of them were never audited at all.
